text: {"label":"Gambling Behavior and Disordered Gambling","definition":"Experimental, verbal-relational, and clinical analyses of gambling, including near-miss effects, slot machine and roulette simulations, animal gambling models, rule-governed risky betting, and acceptance-based treatment of disordered gambling.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Focuses specifically on gambling and its treatment, rather than general reinforcement choice and conditioned reinforcement, broad behavioral economics, or quantitative models of choice and preference."}
